description: This Java class 'EvaluateEcuDefinition' retrieves ECU definitions from a map based on ECU ID, returning either the found definition or a default 'unknown' definition.

classes.name: EvaluateEcuDefinition
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve ECU definitions based on ECU ID from a map.

methods.name: getDef
methods.description: Returns the ECU definition for a given ECU ID from the provided map, or a default 'unknown' definition if not found.
